svg.text: QUESTIONS TO ANSWER AT EACH STEP

text.font-family: Inter Display, Inter, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: Prepare, build and close: steps 08–17

text.font-family: Inter Display, Inter, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: Site setup
How do robots know where they are on this
site?
Where is the refill and battery station?
Where is the safety zone, and who guards
it?
How do we measure wind and temperature?

text.font-family: Inter Display, Inter, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: Dry run
G4 · Safety gate
Do the robots follow the path within
tolerance?
Do they keep safe spacing at the tightest
layer?
Is the team ready to start printing?

text.font-family: Inter Display, Inter, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: Load
Is the mix still within its open time?
Is the battery enough for this layer?

text.font-family: Inter Display, Inter, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: Deposit
Is the robot tracking the path?
Is the flow matching the flight speed?

text.font-family: Inter Display, Inter, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: Scan
Is the scan complete, with no gaps?

text.font-family: Inter Display, Inter, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: Evaluate
Is the layer within tolerance?
Has the layer below cured enough?
Does the next stage stay stable?
Are wind and temperature within limits?

text.font-family: Inter Display, Inter, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: Adapt
Can an offset fix the drift?
Is the drift large enough to redesign
upper layers?
Has the change been logged as a new
version?

text.font-family: Inter Display, Inter, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: Layer gate
Layer gate
Go, hold or adjust for the next layer?
If a robot failed: reassign or stop at
this layer?
Who decided, and on what evidence?

text.font-family: Inter Display, Inter, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: Final validation
G5 · Acceptance gate
Does the as-built match the design within
tolerance?
Accept, accept with notes, or remediate?

text.font-family: Inter Display, Inter, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: Handover
What did we learn about limits, mixes and
weather?
What goes into the next project's
defaults?
Is every decision traceable to its
evidence?
Steps from the example production process (asset 14). Amber cards are decision gates.
